text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju

(Jambatan Kedua Pulau Pinang) (Pindaan) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 April 2014.

Pindaan tajuk

2. Perintah Had Laju (Jambatan Kedua Pulau Pinang) 2014 [P.U. (A) 52/2014], yang

disebut "Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam tajuk dengan menggantikan

perkataan "(JAMBATAN KEDUA PULAU PINANG)" dengan perkataan

"(JAMBATAN SULTAN ABDUL HALIM MU'ADZAM SHAH)".

Pindaan perenggan 1

3. Subperenggan 1(1) Perintah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan perkataan

"(Jambatan Kedua Pulau Pinang)" dengan perkataan "(Jambatan Sultan Abdul

Halim Mu'adzam Shah)".

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

4. Jadual Pertama kepada Perintah ibu dipinda dalam ruang (1), dengan

menggantikan perkataan "Jambatan Kedua Pulau Pinang" dengan perkataan "Jambatan

Sultan Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah".

Pindaan Jadual Kedua

5. Jadual Kedua kepada Perintah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peta dengan

peta yang berikut:

JADUAL KEDUA

"PETA JAMBATAN SULTAN ABDUL HALIM MU'ADZAM SHAH

Dibuat 28 Mac 2014

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/31; PN(PU2)460/LXXIV]

DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

SELAT SELATAN

".

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (SECOND PENANG BRIDGE) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Second Penang Bridge)

(Amendment) Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 April 2014.

Amendment of title

2. The Speed Limit (Second Penang Bridge) Order 2014 [P.U. (A) 52/2014], which

is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in the title by

substituting for the words "(SECOND PENANG BRIDGE)" the words

"(JAMBATAN SULTAN ABDUL HALIM MU'ADZAM SHAH)".

Amendment of paragraph 1

3. Subparagraph 1(1) of the principal Order is amended by substituting for the

words "(Second Penang Bridge)" the words "(Jambatan Sultan Abdul Halim

Mu'adzam Shah)".

Amendment of First Schedule

4. The First Schedule to the principal Order is amended in column (1), by

substituting for the words "Second Penang Bridge" the words "Jambatan Sultan Abdul

Halim Mu'adzam Shah".

Amendment of Second Schedule

5. The Second Schedule to the principal Order is amended by substituting for the

map the following map:

SECOND SCHEDULE

"MAP OF JAMBATAN SULTAN ABDUL HALIM MU'ADZAM SHAH

Made 28 March 2014

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/31; PN(PU2)460/LXXIV]

DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Minister of Works

SOUTH CHANNEL

".
